episodes.title: Princess Is Assassinated So Choi Yong Searches For A Doctor
episodes.summary: Princess Nogoog gets injured but there is no doctor in Goryeo that can save her from dying. So King Gongmin orders General Choi Young to go through "heaven's door" and find God's doctor.

episodes.title: Eun Su's Way Back Home Is Blocked
episodes.summary: Now that the Princess is out of danger, General Choi Young wants to return Doctor Yoo Eun Soo to where she belongs as he promised her. But King Gongmin has other plans for her and wants to keep her in Goryeo.

episodes.title: Choi Yong Investigates The Gas Poisoning
episodes.summary: After the king?s order forces him to renege on his word of honor, Choi Young impales himself on his sword, Eun-soo steps in, intent on saving his life. Choi Young wakes in the morning, he issues instructions for immediate departure. The party arrives in the capital and enters the palace grounds.Yet they find the courtyard completely empty but for a few guards stationed at their posts, which seems odd. No statesmen to greet them after all.

episodes.title: Eun Su Is Dubbed
episodes.summary: Doctor Yoo Eun Soo is still trying to assimilate the fact that she is hundreds of years in the past. The King asks Doctor Yoo Eun Soo to be the Royal Doctor of the Palace. Rumors spread throughout town, that the Doctor/God from heaven can bring the dead back to life and forsee the future. General Choi Young finally reveals to the king why he wants to leave the palace. He was part of Red Crescent Moon Warriors and was forced/sworn to guard the former King.

episodes.title: Choi Yong Wakes Up And Intends To Take Eun Su Away
episodes.summary: Prince Cheol tries to ridicule the king, saying that General Choi Young has made up everything about the Doctor coming from heaven. General's wound gets infected/heart stops beating, Doctor does CPR brings him back to life. Prince Cheol confesses he killed the traitors that were poisoned, to protect the king. King decides to accept Prince's request to take the Doctor(Eun Soo) with him. Doctor is dragged away. Disobeying King's orders General Choi goes to save the Doctor.

episodes.title: Ki Chul Frames Choi Yong For Causing Rebellion
episodes.summary: General Choi Young goes to save the High Doctor from Prince Gi Cheol. Prince Gi Cheol tells them that the High Doctor must go and heal Prince Kyeong Chang (who was supposed to be King but is dying from an illness). If High Doctor is unable to heal the Prince she will be killed for deceiving everyone that she came from the heavens. Prince Gi Choel sets the General a trap; he tells the King that General has kidnapped the High Doctor to heal Prince Kyeong Chang, with plans to dethrone him.

episodes.title: Chang Jun Is Killed By Poison For Saving Choi Yong
episodes.summary: General Choi Young and Doctor Eun Soo escape, and take the young Prince Kyeong Chang to a safe place. Woodalchi Warriors are all arrested and accused of betraying the King, for secretly keeping in contact with General Choi Young. In order to save General Choi Young's life, Prince Kyeong Chang drinks poison given to him by Prince Gi Cheol. Choi Young ends his suffering by stabbing him with a knife.

episodes.title: Choi Yong Escapes From Prison
episodes.summary: General Choi Young is arrested and charged for treason. High Doctor is taken away by Prince Gi Choel. High Doctor asks Prince Gi Choel to save Choi Young, he tells her that she must give him her heart in order to save Choi Young. King personally interrogates Choi Young; Choi Young's actions were only to carry out the King's mission. King and Queen remove their Yuan attire and put on the Gorgeo one.

episodes.title: The Name Shown On The Relic Of Hua Tuo
episodes.summary: King summons General Choi Young and the Woodalchi Warriors, charges against Choi Young are lifted and Woodalchi Warriors given a special right where no one is to interfere with them. Queen pretends to be ill in order to bring Doctor Eun Soo back to the palace. Royal questioning is held and Governor of Ganghwa is charged for plotting treason against the King. Doctor Eun Soo being his accomplice must stay in the palace as the Royal Doctor.

episodes.title: The Ministers List Is Stolen
episodes.summary: With the help of the Woodalchi Warriors, the King tries to mobilize supporters but things doesn't go as planned when Prince Gi Choel gets a hold of the list, which contains the names of the potential supporters. Meanwhile, tension is high between Choi Young and Eun Soo and Eun Soo is trying to figure out what her present and her decisions in Gorgeo effects the course of history and how it effects the life of Choi Young.

episodes.title: Eun Su Changes Her Mind Before Leaving
episodes.summary: Gi Cheol threatens the king by killing scholars. Choi Young rescues Eun-soo from harm's way. To protect Choi Young, Eun-soo leaves soon after telling Choi Young to forget the promise he initially made to her.

episodes.title: Eun Su And Choi Yong Trust Each Other
episodes.summary: Choi Young duels a death match with Gi Cheol. Eun-soo comes in between them to save Choi Young. Eun-soo gives the idea to become partners with Choi Young since she can't run away.

episodes.title: Ki Chul Sets Choi Yong Up
episodes.summary: Choi Young regains laughter through Eun-soo, but Gi Cheol plots to have Lord Deuk-heung become the new king. Appointed scholars carry out ways that support the country in mind.

episodes.title: Eun Su Is Poisoned
episodes.summary: Choi Young confessed that he was bribed and the king sentenced him in 1 year hard labor,but he escaped and run away with the high doctor..meanwhile king's uncle,who is trying to become king,anounce to court lady(choi young's aunt) that the papers which high doctor used for copying her notebook were filled with poison and that after some days and without antidote she will die

episodes.title: Ki Chul Forces The King To Abdicate
episodes.summary: Choi Young meets up with Lord Deuk-heung to set things straight. Lord Deuk-heung gives a ludicrous demand in exchange for the antibiotic.

episodes.title: The Diary Reveals The Secret
episodes.summary: Cho Il-shin's coup d'état results in the king beings displaced from the palace for safety reasons. Choi Young faces off with Lord Deuk-heung and Lord Gi Cheol to defend the king's throne. Eun-soo lays out a plan that relates to heaven's door.

episodes.title: To Save Choi Yong
episodes.summary: Choi Young find out Eun Soo's part in why he was kept alive and sets out to save her. Meanwhile, the King, staying in his own palace in the village, recive Goryeo's new seal and have to deal with the consequences of what Eun Soo's and Prince Deok Heung's deal can mean for his and the Queen's future

episodes.title: A Mysterious Letter
episodes.summary: Choi Young's act of defiance crashes the wedding. While waiting for the king's return, he sets out a plot by asking for help from the royal soldiers. The king is on his way back while Woo Dal Chi protects him from Lord Gi Cheol's soldiers.

episodes.title: The Queen Goes Missing
episodes.summary: The Yuan ambassador gives conditions on who will get the throne between the present king and Lord Deuk-heung. Choi Young and Eun-soo runs away, but obstacles complicate and endanger the run.

episodes.title: Eun Su Joins The Yudachi Army
episodes.summary: The queen's kidnapping creates disorder within the palace. The king starts to feel distraught and frantic. Choi Young and Eun-soo return to the palace and plans to find the queen.

episodes.title: Uprising In The Palace
episodes.summary: Eun-soo stays safe by becoming a member of Woo Dal Chi. Out of betrayal, Gi Cheol tries to attack the royal palace.

episodes.title: Failure To Detoxify
episodes.summary: The king fears of an uprising from the scholars and decides to become a bait to persuade them. Choi Young returns and picks up his sword again to protect the king.

episodes.title: Detoxify With A New Inspiration
episodes.summary: Eun-soo still has hopes to cure poison by an antidote while she worries about Choi Young's arm. Gi Cheol is on the run and puts up one last attack.

episodes.title: Eun Su And Choi Yong Get Together In The End
episodes.summary: Eun-soo's body battles all night to cure the poison. Gi Cheol kidnaps Eun-soo to go through heaven's door together. Eun-soo starts to cry after seeing the third relic.
